legacy_journey.title: Typical phone banking today
legacy_journey.outcome: Deflected. Told to download the app to reach a person; the problem is not resolved.

steps.label: Automated menu
steps.detail: "Press 1 for accounts, press 2 for cards..." The caller listens to every option and guesses which one fits.

steps.label: Enter your account number
steps.detail: The caller has to find their account number and key it in on the phone.

steps.label: Enter your passkey
steps.detail: A passkey most customers do not remember, keyed in on the phone.

steps.label: Hold queue
steps.detail: Hold music while waiting for someone to pick up.

steps.label: Told to download the app for a person
steps.detail: Asking for a specialist ends with "please download the app and press the support button".

ai_journey.title: With an AI specialist
ai_journey.outcome: Resolved on the call, or handed to a human specialist who already has the full context.

steps.label: Answered instantly
steps.detail: No menu. The AI specialist picks up and starts talking.

steps.label: Caller ID recognised
steps.detail: The caller is greeted by name. No account number is asked for.

steps.label: Identity confirmed by app push
steps.detail: One tap on a notification in the banking app. No passkey, and no voice-only identity.

steps.label: Resolved in conversation
steps.detail: The AI proposes, policy decides: done straight away, or a case goes to staff with the evidence attached.

steps.label: Or: a human specialist joins with full context
steps.detail: Asking for a person gets a person, routed by skill, who can already see the transcript and the case.
